posts.title: Windows has the best visual timer
posts.description: Every time I want to use pomodoro or a timer for a chunk of focused work I end up with the same question: why can't I turn off the numbers on the timers? There is a very different feeling to look at a timer with a number counting down and a timer with just a progress bar going down. The precision of the numbers make the timer more of a stressful element for me where it is harder to get into flow.
